Revenue Revenue increased $26.6 million, or 57%, to $72.9 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $46.3 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase in revenue was primarily attributable to a 89% increase in revenue case volume, partially offset by a reduction in average sales price due to a higher percentage of revenue cases generated from clinic and office-based accounts and an increase in volume rebates.

Sales and marketing Sales and marketing expense was $7.9 million and $6.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, an increase of $1.0 million, or 15.3%. The increase is due to increased marketing-related events and expenses primarily associated with the commercialization of the Technology segment, and employee expenses, partially offset by a decrease in marketing related professional fees.

Revenue Revenue decreased by $0.2 million, or 1%, to $23.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $23.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The decrease in revenue was primarily due to a $0.6 million decrease in service revenue offset by a $0.3 million increase in revenue from sales of our RNS System units.

Revenues Revenues increased by $71.8 million to $96.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025, reflecting higher Rumble revenues and the contribution of Quake AI.

Operating income Operating income increased by $819,000, or 30.7%, to $3,489,000, or 18.7% of net revenues, for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period in the prior year. The increase was primarily due to an increase in revenue and gross profit.

Total revenue decreased by $6.2 or 2.8% and increased by $11.4 or 1.7% for the three and nine month periods ended October 3, 2026 compared to the three and nine month periods ended September 27, 2025. The decrease in the three month period was primarily attributable to the continuation of organic volume declines associated with uncertainty in the macroeconomic environment, sustained elevated interest rates, along with lower housing churn which was not fully offset by inorganic revenues of $10.7 from the Kiwi II acquisition.

Revenue Three months ended Revenue for the three months ended October 3, 2026 was $727 million, an increase of $24 million, or 3.4%, compared to the same period in 2025. The increase was primarily due to $29 million from favorable price, partially offset by $4 million of unfavorable impacts from foreign currency exchange rates and $2 million from lower sales volume.

Revenue for the nine months ended October 4, 2026 was $1,100.1 million, as compared to $1,049.1 million for the nine months ended September 28, 2025, an increase of $51.0 million, or 5%. The increase in our Life Sciences segment revenue during the nine months ended October 4, 2026 was driven by an increase of $38.1 million in Life Sciences Solutions revenue and an increase of $12.9 million in Software revenue.

Revenue The Company’s revenue increased 121% in the third quarter of 2026, as compared to the third quarter of 2025 and 110% for the first nine months of 2026 as compared to the first nine months of 2025, primarily driven by $896 million and $2.2 billion of revenue contributed by the BDS Business for the third quarter and since the Closing Date for the first nine months of 2026, respectively.

Consolidated revenue increased $263.0 million or 17% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, due to a $196.9 million or 13% increase from asset-based fees and a $66.1 million or 4% increase from performance-based fees, primarily in private markets strategies.

Revenue increased primarily due to a $24.2 million, or 10.3%, increase in revenue in our Health+ Segment, and an $8.9 million, or 3.6%, increase in revenue in our Military+ Segment, partially offset by an $8.0 million decrease in GSUSA revenue included in Corporate and Other for the period prior to the GSUSA Sale Date.

Revenue share increased by $39.5 million or 32.6% to $160.7 million for the six months ended September 30, 2026, and was 46.6% as a percentage of total net revenue compared to $121.2 million, or 44.7% of total net revenue, for the six months ended September 30, 2025. The increase in revenue share was attributable to the increase in total net revenue over the same periods, as these costs are typically paid as a percentage of our revenue.
